h: The Foods of Ha’azinu Reveal the Torah Within Creation

p: יַרְכִּיבֵהוּ עַל בָּמֳתֵי אָרֶץ (דְּבָרִים לב, יג)
"He made him ride upon the heights of the earth" (Devarim 32:13).
which is higher than all the lands," etc.
And certainly the intent is not
in that it sits on a mountain,
for there are mountains outside the Land
that it is high in stature,
"Ten measures of wisdom came down to the world;
And this is what is said: yarkiveihu
upon the heights of the earth;
that is, the air of Eretz Yisrael,
כְּעֵין מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא קנח, ב
"The air of Eretz Yisrael makes one wise."
"and he ate the produce of the field";
that is, to rectify the whole root of the blemish,
that the eating be words of Torah,
and the wine of the Oral Torah"
And they correspond to the four letters of Havayah;
there are the souls of Yisrael,
corresponding to the tip of the yud;
and they correspond to the four worlds,
And in all the elements there are words of Torah.
is the words of Torah in the inanimate,
which even an unlearned person attains,
"An inheritance of the congregation of Yaakov,"
שֶׁנִּקְרְאוּ בֵּית יַעֲקֹב (בָּבָא מְצִיעָא לג, ב)
who are called "the house of Yaakov" (Bava Metzia 33b).
"and he ate the produce of the field,"
which is from the words of Torah
הוּא רַק עַל יְדֵי תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
is only through the Oral Torah,
And this is what it says in the Sifrei (Sifrei Devarim 317):
"'And he ate the produce of the field'
'and He nursed him with honey from the rock'
And therefore it put first "the produce of the field,"
the letters of the Name Shakai,
שֵׁם שֶׁל יְסוֹד (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג יא, ב)
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קעח, ב וְשָׁאָר מְקוֹמוֹת)
and the small yud of this Name,
it is impregnated and becomes a hei;
the small yud of the covenant;
the secret of the three Avos,
who are all the root of the words of Torah
(as has been explained several times at length);
which corresponds to the World of Yetzirah,
which is half bad and half good,
and through the words of Torah
"And He nursed him with honey from the rock":
to sense the reasons of Torah (Pesachim 119a),
and through this he will sense taste
and will have desire for words of Torah.
And afterward, "and oil from the flinty rock":
that Hashem Yisbarach will shine into him,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (מְנָחוֹת פה, ב)
along the lines of what they said (Menachos 85b):
"Since they are accustomed to olive oil,
This corresponds to the World of Asiyah,
and through the words of Torah
they will make it entirely from the side of good.
"Curd of cattle and milk of sheep":
that is, what comes from the animal;
corresponds to the World of Beriah,
which is mostly good and a little bad;
and "blood is decomposed and becomes milk"
that is, the bad is transformed
"With the fat of lambs and rams":
"that they have not eaten the meat of an ox,"
"I did not examine the reason of the matter"
And it says "the fat of lambs," etc.:
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא כב, א)
according to what they said (Bava Basra 22a):
"They ate fat meat at Rava's house."
And therefore it is said thus,
for this is a distinct matter;
that the forbidden is transformed into the permitted,
of the body of the words of Torah,
with the fat of kidneys of wheat":
how it is included in the Written Torah,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (נְדָרִים כב, ב)
along the lines of what they said (Nedarim 22b):
only the five books of the Torah," etc.;
וְהָיוּ יוֹדְעִין כׇּל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
and they would have known the whole Oral Torah
and as it will be in the future
And it says "the fat of kidneys"
that is, there are two kidneys,
And here they will merit both kidneys:
that words of Torah will enter
the heart of the wise man at his right;
that he will uproot the bad
And this corresponds to the holiness of Avraham,
wisdom in the heart of the wise man at his right,
and the holiness of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
which enters the heart of the fool
to conquer and overpower the evil inclination.
the twenty-two letters of the Torah,
corresponding to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
And this is what is said, "and he-goats":
for it is stated in the Sifrei (Sifrei Devarim 317):
which a person reasons out on his own.
And all the roots of the Oral Torah:
"with the fat of kidneys of wheat"
which are the body of the Torah,
as written in the Sifrei (Sifrei Devarim 317);
which are all alluded to in the Written Torah;
וּמִשּׁוּם הָכֵי כְּתִיב כָּאן גַּם כֵּן
and therefore it writes here too
"with," for it is a distinct matter.
to what is said, "and he ate";
that is, all the words of Torah that they will merit,
and all the details of the Oral Torah
and corresponding to them is the World of Beriah,
"And the blood of the grape you shall drink, wine":
the wine of the Oral Torah.
which is the choicest of wine,
"Do not look at wine when it is red"
the words of Torah from the side of Hashem Yisbarach;
"and drink of the wine I have mixed";
is the effort from the side of man;
and here it says "you shall drink,"
the wine and the Oral Torah.
That is, in the days of Mashiach,
and secrets of the Oral Torah will be revealed,
כׇּל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁאַתְּ לָמֵד בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה
"All the Torah that you learn in this world
compared to the Torah of the World to Come."
And therefore it writes here chamer (wine)
which the ministering angels do not recognize,
for then the secrets of the Torah will be revealed;
and so that the angels not be jealous,
(and so most of the secrets of the Torah were set down
And this corresponds to the words of Torah
which corresponds to the World of Atzilus
and the letter yud of the Name Havayah;
and this will be revealed in the future,
who will be revealed speedily in our days.

paragraphs.text: Source: Kohelet Rabbah 2:1 — “… רבי סימון בר זבדי אמר כל התורה שאת למד בעולם הזה הבל הוא לפני תורה שבעולם הבא, לפי שבעולם הזה אדם למד תורה ושוכח, אבל לעתיד לבוא מה כתיב תמן …” — ““I said in my heart: Come now, I will experiment in joy, and see goodness; and, behold, it too is vanity” (Ecclesiastes 2:1).“I said in my heart: Come now, I will experiment in joy” – Rabbi Pinḥas and Rabbi Ḥizkiyya …”
